QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Sunny Space
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Alvin and clean up the house.
QuestInfo.1:
Alvin suggests placing your bed near a sunny window.
In order to move your bed, click the #i3801392##t3801392# button in the Home menu to upon Edit mode.
QuestInfo.2: Now that you've moved your bed near the window, why not have a little lie down and see if you like its new spot? Stand near the bed and #bclick#k it to use it!
